# PowerLink v1.0.3 — Official HACS catalog readiness

This maintenance release prepares PowerLink for submission to the official Home Assistant Community Store (HACS) integration catalog.

## What's changed

- Added automatic validation using the official **HACS Action** and **Home Assistant hassfest**.
- Made the integration manifest conform to hassfest's required field ordering and added the TV & Streaming integration category.
- Corrected an HTML-like example in options-flow help text so Home Assistant translations validate cleanly.
- Confirmed that the approved PowerLink artwork, HACS repository layout, license, and other repository checks pass.

## Compatibility

**No changes to device discovery, Fire TV power/wake routines, PowerShuffle, queue matching, playback handoff, Home Assistant entities, or integration behavior.**

No migration or reconfiguration is necessary. Update through HACS, then restart Home Assistant if prompted.

The existing GPLv3 licensing and source notices are unchanged.
